JACS verification works without contacting any server.

sources.note: JACS 是与我们最贴面的对手：同样宣称 AI agent runtime、离线验签、去中心化、无需中央设施。该页面同时声明可能含未发布变更，故其行只能按 self_reported 处理。

quotes: in-toto is designed to ensure the integrity of a software product from initiation to end-user installation. It does so by making it transparent to the user what steps were performed, by whom and in what order.
in-toto is a CNCF graduated project.
sources.note: in-toto 的元数据单位是「每一步的 link 文件」，由各自的 functionary 签名；它的语义重心是供应链构建步骤，不是运行时 agent 动作。

quotes: SLSA is a specification for describing and incrementally improving supply chain security, established by industry consensus. It is organized into a series of levels that describe increasing security guarantees.
sources.note: SLSA 是分级要求（levels）而非签名工具；它约束构建平台可信度，不提供「运行时动作的步级定位」。

quotes: Registering signed statements with a Transparency Service (TS) is akin to a notarization procedure.
Receipt: a COSE Single Signer Data Object as defined in [RFC9942].
Receipt Profiles implemented by a TS MUST support inclusion proofs and MAY support other Proof Types (see Section 3 of [RFC9942]), such as consistency proofs.
Signed Statements can be made transparent by attaching a proof of Registration by a TS in the form of a Receipt.
sources.note: SCITT 的可验证性锚在 Transparency Service 上：没有注册就没有 Receipt。Receipt 的数学验证本身可离线做，但「透明」这一属性依赖 TS 存在。

claims_we_test: 离线验签在我们这里是否真的成立（含导入期不加载网络栈）
验证是否需要外部日志/CA/TS（输入面）
是否能定位到具体步号（而非只判整体有效/无效）
单凭证覆盖 N 步的体积与耗时相对逐步骤签名如何
拒绝时是否给结构化代码而不是抛异常
信任分离是否为 VALID_UNTRUSTED_KEY 而非裸 VALID
claims_we_do_not_test: Sigstore/Rekor 的 Merkle 包含证明性能（未安装 sigstore 客户端，S5 未做同机实验）
in-toto 完整 layout 验证（in_toto_verify）的端到端耗时（只测了 link 级签/验）
SCITT TS 的真实部署行为（无实现）
JACS 的任何数字（其页面无量化指标，仅能力勾选）
